Cavelle is a floating assets sales and sourcing company. We do not manufacture, build or construct floating assets or vessels and do not own a shipyard or manufacturing facility. Asset availability, specifications and pricing are confirmed directly by our sales team and are subject to change. Commercial, rental, hospitality and business uses of any asset are subject to local regulations, marina requirements, permits and applicable law.
